verdict.rationale: Flagright's homepage claims built-in 'explainable AI agents' that 'supercharge AML operations' and describes case management as having 'AI-native workflows', so the product does market its own in-product AI agents. That support amounts to a single-line marketing mention, with no documentation of what tasks can be delegated or how users invoke the agents. The docs MCP server is a documentation aid for external AI clients, not an in-product assistant, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: documentation of the assistant's capabilities and delegable tasks, a description of how users interact with it in the console, any hands-on or independent corroboration.
